cards.art: Moose in powdered wig surrounded by paper notes in cavern
cards.lore: The first institution to monopolize the creation of official domestic currency.
cards.name: The Riksbank (1668)
cards.power: Play to establish a Central Bank monopoly. Opponents must trade physical gold for paper promises.

cards.art: Bulldog in top hat spinning gold coins from spinning wheel
cards.lore: The blueprint for global financial control, turning sovereign debt into private profit.
cards.name: Bank of England (1694)
cards.power: Generate infinite liquidity out of nothing.

cards.art: Rooster in Napoleon coat prodding giant HYPERINFLATION balloon over fleeing citizens
cards.lore: Founded by Napoleon to fight rampant revolutionary inflation by centralizing the money supply.
cards.name: Banque de France (1800)
cards.power: Stabilize your own currency by inflating your opponents' assets until they burst.

cards.art: Cloaked vulture figures signing glowing contract under green light
cards.lore: The paradigm shift. The true empire runs on contracts and liabilities, not standing armies.
cards.name: Federal Reserve Act (1913)
cards.power: Shift the game from national control to global market consolidation.

cards.art: Giant printing press train flooding village with cascading cash, badger fleeing
cards.lore: The era of unbacked fiat money requires constant inflation to sustain the illusion.
cards.name: The Fiat Flood
cards.power: Devalue all active currency tokens on the board.

cards.art: Sheep lining up to feed coins into cash register marked SAFE INVESTMENT
cards.lore: A form of state crowdfunding where the notoriously broke government sells IOUs to its own citizens.
cards.name: Government Bonds (The Crowdfund)
cards.power: Trick opponents into lending you capital for negative real returns.

cards.art: Demonic cuckoo clock showing EUR/sec readout, tortoise crushed under DEBT sacks below
cards.lore: States are bankrupt. They have zero realistic chance of ever paying off their central bank masters.
cards.name: The German Debt Clock
cards.power: Apply a permanent debt-drain to one player. It will take until the year 2232 to clear.

cards.art: Fox magician and wolf assistant extracting cash from hat before animal audience
cards.lore: Your taxes don't fund the government; they just maintain the illusion that the money printer isn't running.
cards.name: The Taxation Illusion
cards.power: Extract wealth from players via subsidies and eco-indulgences.

cards.art: Walrus with 1907 CRISIS magnet vacuum-inhaling gold coins over collapsing factory skyline
cards.lore: Hailed as a savior for fixing the 1907 crisis he allegedly helped engineer to secure his monopoly.
cards.name: J.P. Morgan's Magnet
cards.power: Trigger a financial panic to consolidate all remaining wealth tokens.

cards.art: Banker pigs on stage handing money bag to wolf investigator behind curtain
cards.lore: The 1912 congressional hearings merely paved the way for the creation of the Federal Reserve.
cards.name: The Pujo Committee Kabuki
cards.power: Nullify any Regulatory Investigation card played against you.

cards.art: Hyena in suit with abacus, standing on skull pile in blood-soaked ledger room
cards.lore: Hitler's Banker and founding member of the BIS expert commission. Capital has no morals.
cards.name: Hjalmar Schacht (The Hyena)
cards.power: Markets love totalitarian regimes. Gain double resources from authoritarian players.

cards.art: American eagle and German eagle shaking wings in front of smokestack factory
cards.lore: Wall Street elites, including Prescott Bush, collaborated with Fritz Thyssen to finance the fascist war machine.
cards.name: Union Banking Corp.
cards.power: Secretly fund your opponent's enemies for future leverage.

cards.art: Two owl figures playing Ouija board over glowing globe in dark tower
cards.lore: The Bank for International Settlements (1930). The oldest, most powerful, and least accountable financial organization on Earth.
cards.name: The BIS (Basel Tower)
cards.power: The ultimate command center. Override any national banking rule in play.

cards.art: Shark in suit dangling rescue rope to drowning frog while attaching chains to its ankles
cards.lore: Born at Bretton Woods (1944) to ensure the US Dollar became the undisputed global reserve currency.
cards.name: The IMF (Loan Shark)
cards.power: Rescue a bankrupt player, but take permanent control of their infrastructure.

cards.art: Teal snake coiled around globe squeezing gold coins into small collector bag
cards.lore: Funneling wealth from the Global South into the coffers of a few elite families.
cards.name: The World Bank
cards.power: Issue development loans that can never be fully repaid.

cards.art: UN tank driving through pastoral village with peace-sign poster in front
cards.lore: Pluralism simulation. The decorative facade of international diplomacy masking corporate empire.
cards.name: The UN / League of Nations
cards.power: Disguise aggressive financial expansion as peacekeeping.

cards.art: Bald eagle with US-flag armor dragging pig civilians into war-debt machine
cards.lore: The Federal Reserve financed the bloodshed of WWI to enable the full internationalization of the central bank system.
cards.name: Liberty Loans
cards.power: Convert civilian wealth directly into military debt.

cards.art: Gift-wrapped dynamite bundle with 20 YEARS timer and Versailles wax seal
cards.lore: Not a peace treaty, but an armistice for twenty years. - Ferdinand Foch, accurately predicting the cartel's next harvest.
cards.name: The Versailles Truce
cards.power: Pause conflict, but double the cost of the next war.

cards.art: Groundhog with Swiss flag halo sitting on gold pile, watches, teeth, stolen paintings
cards.lore: Hoarding dictator wealth and stolen assets while pretending the Alps are made of pure morality.
cards.name: Swiss Vault Neutrality
cards.power: Store illicit wealth with absolute impunity. Immune to audits.

cards.art: Bald vulture in suit measuring rubble with tape measure, briefcase open, city on fire behind
cards.lore: Forcing a war-torn nation to sell its mineral wealth and state assets to pay off reconstruction debt.
cards.name: The Ukraine Rebuild (BlackRock)
cards.power: Exploit a crisis to forcibly privatize an opponent's state assets.

cards.art: Chameleon in suit handing glowing briefcase bomb to stunned lemur official
cards.lore: Highly paid professionals who defraud countries of trillions via fraudulent reports, bribery, and extortion.
cards.name: The Economic Hit Man
cards.power: Trick an opponent into accepting a loan that ruins their economy.

cards.art: Military monkey operatives in sunglasses escorting sloth president with money bag
cards.lore: If a government shows no interest in dictated financial policy, they are swiftly acquainted with harder arguments.
cards.name: Regime Change (United Fruit)
cards.power: Remove a non-compliant leader from the board. Costs 3 covert tokens.

cards.art: Giant mechanical dragonfly with glowing tubes drilling into scorched earth landscape
cards.lore: The true goal of development loans: permanent control over natural resources.
cards.name: Resource Extraction
cards.power: Drain 1 resource token per turn from a developing nation.

cards.art: Industrial vice squeezing island nation map, water leaking into oil drums below
cards.lore: Liberalization simply means stealing the commons to feed the cartel.
cards.name: The Privatization Vise
cards.power: Force an indebted player to sell their public utilities to your corporate deck.

cards.art: Snake in cardinal robes washing gold coins in holy water font, blood dripping below
cards.lore: Capital: 600 Million officially. Realistically? 600 Billion in blood-soaked history.
cards.name: IOR (Institute for Works of Religion)
cards.power: Launder infinite criminal wealth with divine diplomatic immunity.

cards.art: Crocodiles in fedoras watching card pyramid collapse over APPROVED stamp
cards.lore: Arms trafficking, money laundering, and deals with the Mafia and the P2 Masonic Lodge.
cards.name: Banco Ambrosiano Collapse
cards.power: Shift all your debt to an offshore shell company right before it explodes.

cards.art: Rat in wet suit hanging from bridge arch in rain, bricks in pockets, dark Thames below
cards.lore: The 120kg head of Banco Ambrosiano, silenced before he could sing about the missing $250 million in IOR deposits.
cards.name: Roberto Calvi's Bridge
cards.power: Suicide a problematic witness. Target player discards their hand.

cards.art: Frog in orange prison jumpsuit holding steaming skull-marked coffee cup
cards.lore: The Howard Hughes of Italy, deeply tied to the Vatican, silenced with cyanide coffee in prison (1986).
cards.name: Michele Sindona's Espresso
cards.power: Poison the opponent's strongest asset. Unblockable.

cards.art: Eight-armed octopus teller with rifles, rockets, and briefcases at TELLER window
cards.lore: 400 branches in 78 countries. Core business: bribery, terror financing, trafficking, and nuclear tech sales.
cards.name: BCCI (The Sleaziest Bank)
cards.power: Generate phantom loans to cover massive illegal operations.

cards.art: Three monkeys with green military blindfolds on burning cash pile, APPROVED stamp visible
cards.lore: Elite consulting firms deliberately ignored that BCCI was functionally insolvent and acting as a Deep State satellite.
cards.name: The Price Waterhouse Blindfold
cards.power: Ignore all insolvency penalties for 10 turns.

cards.art: Wolf in fedora delivering FARMING EQUIPMENT crates to scorpion official, missiles visible inside
cards.lore: BCCI helped funnel millions through the Banca Nazionale del Lavoro to arm Iraq, guided by Deep State consultants.
cards.name: Saddam's BNL Secret
cards.power: Secure $4 Billion in secret loans for weapons procurement.

cards.art: Goat figure reading 'How to Hide Money in Nassau' book with CIA bird whispering instructions
cards.lore: The CIA used BCCI to teach future enemies the dark arts of offshore finance and jihad funding.
cards.name: Osama's Offshore Wallet
cards.power: Set up an untraceable Al-Taqwa shell company.

cards.art: Iguana gangster feeding glowing green bags into industrial washing machines, bull banker collecting clean bills
cards.lore: According to the UNODC, cartels washed over 1.6 Trillion dollars through international financial markets in a single year.
cards.name: The $1.6 Trillion Wash
cards.power: Convert 10 illegal drug tokens into pristine Wall Street capital.

cards.art: Luxury yacht floating on rings of COCAINE-labeled cash bricks amid sunken market
cards.lore: The global financial system would have collapsed in 2008 if it hadn't absorbed billions in drug money—the only liquid capital left.
cards.name: The 2008 Buffer
cards.power: Survive a total market collapse using liquid underworld capital.

cards.art: Tiger gangster and tuxedo pig toasting champagne at table covered in drug money
cards.lore: A fruitful collaboration between state, banks, and cartels. Laws and morals are pure wastepaper.
cards.name: The War on Drugs Loop
cards.power: Expand the Police State without ever reducing the contraband supply.

cards.art: Black stealth aircraft dropping money bags into glowing safe over night cityscape
cards.lore: Neither the state nor the financial market has any real interest in stopping the fourth-largest trade commodity on Earth.
cards.name: CIA Flight Paths
cards.power: State actors gain a monopoly on black market logistics.

cards.art: Elephant with scissors cutting gold rope from dollar-sign hot air balloon soaring into sky
cards.lore: August 15, 1971. The gold standard is abolished, birthing the modern era of value-less fiat currency.
cards.name: The Nixon Shock (1971)
cards.power: Unpeg your currency. Create money from absolute zero.

cards.art: Owl with pocket watches hypnotizing herd of pigs and sheep into compliance
cards.lore: The doctrine that states should stay out of the economy, leaving ultimate power in the hands of the central bankers.
cards.name: Milton Friedman's Monetarism
cards.power: Control inflation purely by manipulating the money supply, ignoring social costs.

cards.art: Tri-color multi-headed snake coiling around fleeing mice with money bags
cards.lore: The 1972 currency snake that paved the way for a single, unified, centrally planned economic zone.
cards.name: The Euro Snake
cards.power: Bind opponents' economies to yours so they cannot escape a crash.

cards.art: Giant spider on ECB glass tower spinning web over Eurozone map
cards.lore: Established in 1998, a true milestone on the path to absolute financial world domination.
cards.name: The ECB (Frankfurt)
cards.power: Socialize all losses across the entire Eurozone.

cards.art: Hippo in suit holding remote control pointing at collar-shocked dog amid digital towers
cards.lore: We don't know who uses a $100 bill today. The main difference with CBDC is the central bank will have absolute control. – BIS Manager
cards.name: CBDC (The Digital Leash)
cards.power: Central Bank has absolute control over the rules of your money.

cards.art: Mechanical spider in server room vacuuming financial documents, bats hanging above
cards.lore: Centralised interbank communication that openly shares confidential customer data with intelligence agencies.
cards.name: SWIFTNet Data Vacuum
cards.power: Repurpose global transaction data to sanction non-compliant players.

cards.art: Wolves in top hats chainsaw-cutting Bitcoin tree while city towers rise behind
cards.lore: Bitcoin's peer-to-peer threat was neutralised by institutional seeding layers and Wall Street absorption.
cards.name: Crypto-Colonialism
cards.power: Usurp decentralised tech to resubjugate developing nations digitally.

cards.art: Phone-shaped mousetrap snapping over skeletal hand, cash evaporating in digital cityscape
cards.lore: Anonymous wallets and cash will soon belong to the past, replaced by total financial [UNCLEAR — legibility issue in WEB version; verify PRINT_HQ].
cards.name: The Cashless Trap
cards.power: Eliminate anonymity. All non-compliant trades are blocked.

cards.art: Goose in suit blasting frozen wallet ice cubes at angry bears holding protest signs
cards.lore: 210 bank accounts frozen during the 2022 Canadian Freedom Convoy, creating existential dread for dissidents.
cards.name: Trudeau's Account Freeze
cards.power: Freeze all assets of players who protest your rules.

cards.art: Raccoon in suit scooping donation pot into own pocket while robotic bees distract donors
cards.lore: Platform complicity: retaining millions in donations to blindly redirect them to verified charities instead.
cards.name: GoFundMe Theft
cards.power: Canfiscats opponent's crowdfunding and donate it to yourself.

cards.art: Badger bureaucrat stabbing glowing digital stiletto into fox's wallet on stage
cards.lore: Tech-payment monopolies independently authorizing themselves to fine customers for spreading misinformation.
cards.name: PayPal's $2500 Fine
cards.power: Arbitrarily extract $2500 from a player for wrongthink.

cards.art: Pig bureaucrat hitting DELETE PERSON button on surveillance console, player vanishing from screens
cards.lore: The ultimate weapon. If you do not submit to the bio-digital surveillance state, you simply cease to exist financially.
cards.name: Financial Paternalism
cards.power: Erase a non-cooperative player from the market entirely.

cards.art: Gorgon women and centaur chasing centaur citizen into pawn shop, Greek ruins behind
cards.lore: 2010 bailouts. The cradle of democracy put in a permanent chokehold by financial locusts.
cards.name: The Greek Tragedy (Troika)
cards.power: Force an opponent to sell off their entire state infrastructure to you.

cards.art: Ram charging ECB dragon holding scissors at bank vault, Greek flag barely visible
cards.lore: The ECB halted capital flows to Greek banks as retaliation for a democratic referendum against credit-colonialism.
cards.name: Varoufakis vs. Draghi
cards.power: Cut off the capital flow to any nation that votes against you.

cards.art: Dragon hatching from golden egg stepping into NEW CAGE, SAME OWNERS bird cage
cards.lore: A multi-polar world still relies on CBDC currency blocks to guarantee absolute control through the BIS.
cards.name: BRICS New Development Bank
cards.power: Promise an alternative system, but build the exact same panopticon.

cards.art: Bat holding government bond certificate, golden 2.53% dripping into vial below
cards.lore: With debt mathematically unpayable, the only remaining income source is the slow, continuous expropriation of the citizen.
cards.name: The Yield Vampire
cards.power: Collapse bond yields. Make safe investments worthless.

cards.art: Hedgehog crowd storming neo-classical bank with pitchforks, police dogs backing away
cards.lore: If Occupy had become Abolish Wall Street—a true mass protest from below—the world would be different today.
cards.name: Occupy 2.0 (Abolish Wall Street)
cards.power: True mass protest. Nullify all Central Bank cards in play.

cards.art: Macaw parrot pointing at central bank printer with disconnected cable plug
cards.lore: The real problem is that you pay high taxes just to maintain the illusion that you are funding the government—which you aren't.
cards.name: The El Salvador Glitch
cards.power: Expose the illusion. Stop paying taxes that fund nothing.

cards.art: Badger family trading coins and carrots in sunlit forest clearing, smartphone shattering at their feet
cards.lore: Invest in tangible assets, skills, and memories. When the digital system collapses, they cannot take the physical away from you.
cards.name: The Physical Barter (Sachwerte)
cards.power: Move your assets offline. Immune to CBDC freezes.

cards.art: Glowing bear tearing free of debt-web with golden scissors, KayfaBIZARRO! Stay fluffy! erupting around it
cards.lore: Withdraw participation. Cash is resistance. Stay fluffy, and starve the beast.
cards.name: The Sovereign Animal
cards.power: Victory Condition: A free man is one who has no debt.
